 Medium
 Large
 Print The Sun enters Scorpio, your 1st house of self, body and first impressions. Venus, retrograde in the same sign, asks you to review what you truly want. A month of personal energy begins. Decide one thing you will do differently, then start small. Scorpio Career Predictions
 Your presence carries more weight as the month opens. A senior may notice a firmer tone in how you speak about your role. Let results back it up. A goal that felt vague may get a date. Ask for any new duty in writing. And hold back from announcing a big move until the terms are clear. Scorpio Love Predictions
 A partner may see a stronger, more private side of you and ask what has changed. Answer in a few plain lines. Couples can reset a stale habit with one fresh routine. Singles may draw notice without trying. Look for someone who respects your pace. Let trust build before any label. Scorpio Money Predictions
 Personal spending needs a fresh look. A gadget, a grooming plan or a birthday treat may feel urgent. Check your balance first. An old payment made for your own benefit may be worth cancelling. And set a modest limit for the month before the celebrations begin. Scorpio Health Predictions
 Energy lifts, though sleep, throat and lower abdomen may react to emotional strain. Keep meals regular and drink enough water. Avoid sudden crash plans or harsh workouts. A steady routine suits the body better than a sharp push, especially while Venus is retrograde. Scorpio Remedies
 Write two things you want from the coming year and keep the note private. Take a quiet walk at dusk.
